gloss_en: Prayer (tefillah, תְּפִלָּה) — the devotional act of addressing God in praise and petition, the 'service of the heart' (standing worship / the Amidah's eighteen blessings), identified with faith and the power to change nature; NOT the homograph tiflah (תִּפְלָה, 'unseemliness/folly') or tafel ('unseasoned')
